long_biography.plain_text:
Early roles at Seascope and Braemar gave Harry N. Vafias experience in broking, chartering and commercial transactions. Work at Brave Maritime and Stealth Maritime then put him inside the shipping enterprise established by his father, while he developed a specialist path of his own. In 2004, he formed StealthGas around liquefied-petroleum-gas transportation and brought it to Nasdaq the following year.

Imperial Petroleum and C3is extended that strategy into tanker and dry-bulk markets through separate listed corporations. Vafias still runs the first two businesses; at C3is, he holds a non-executive chairmanship while another executive handles daily management. He holds direct and beneficial shareholdings through private entities such as Flawless Management. The fleets, subsidiaries and operating assets, however, belong to their respective companies rather than to Vafias personally.

uncertainties.detail: Current filings and the official company biography consistently use Harry N. Vafias. No reliable reviewed source expands the N., and it is not treated as proof of a middle name such as Nikolaos. Greek-language sources often use Haris or Χάρης Vafias; that is a language form of the same identity, not a reason to alter the established English professional name.

uncertainties.topic: Identity within the Vafias shipping family
uncertainties.detail: Harry is the son of Brave Maritime's founder, identified in public sources as Nikolaos or Nikos Vafias. Current filings separately identify Harry's executive roles, Flawless Management ownership and beneficial holdings, preventing conflation with his father or with non-family executives such as Diamantis Andriotis.

The record supports Self-made — advantaged start rather than purely self-made or inherited-and-expanded. Family support and an established shipping platform materially assisted Harry's entry, but the separate company formation, specialist strategy and public listings demonstrate substantial founder-built expansion rather than passive succession.

StealthGas, Imperial Petroleum, C3is and their subsidiaries own their respective fleets and operating assets. Harry's documented personal economic interests consist of direct or beneficial shareholdings and control of private holding entities such as Flawless Management; company fleet counts and valuations are not treated as his personal property or net worth.

Vafias is C3is's non-executive chairman, while Diamantis Andriotis is its chief executive and president. The dossier therefore describes Vafias as an active operator at StealthGas and Imperial Petroleum but does not misstate him as C3is's day-to-day chief executive.

Current SEC filings report age 48 in March and April 2026, while the input records age 42 in May 2020. Those age observations constrain but do not uniquely determine whether he was born in late 1977 or early 1978. Lower-tier profiles commonly state 1978, but no accepted first-party or strong institutional source establishes a complete birth date, so no birth field is proposed.
